title: A person who recognizes the imaginative layers built into interaction turns private projection into shared experience
body:
- Frame enhancement adds imaginative resonance through metaphor, interiority, narrative texture, and playful projection to interactions
- A practitioner who recognizes these projective layers doesn't just respond to existing frames but actively co-creates shared experiential worlds
- The projective elements that structure interpersonal experience are used by everyone but most don't consciously recognize them as a frame
- Recognizing the projection as a frame rather than treating it as error is what allows the practitioner to build on it
conversion: Private projections that go unrecognized become invisible noise; recognized and built upon, they become the basis for a co-created shared experience.
